definition: A change caused by real physical, customer or vendor evidence
requires: the preserved original and the rule that applies; scores change only by their rules
example: Session 1 result changes the Chicken 65 status

definition: The recorded outcome of a planned test
allowed_when: a test in the protocol was run
requires: the result recorded as it happened, including failure
example: a dish is cut after failing its frozen gates

allowed_when: the founder says so in their own words
requires: a decision row (D-nn) classed FOUNDER CONFIRMED
example: the founder confirms or rejects D-76 or D-77

definition: A change that depends on a qualified professional
allowed_when: a professional has reviewed in writing
requires: the raw written reply preserved; no agent paraphrase as authority
example: an attorney advises changing the name

definition: New material public research that changes a stated fact
allowed_when: a primary or reputable source with date, tier and limit
requires: the source row and the claim it replaces

definition: A fix to an error, label drift or an overstated claim
requires: what was wrong and the fix; no change of meaning disguised as a fix
example: a site sentence overstated its source tier
